test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A woman has invested Rs. 85,000 at a rate of 7(1)/(2)\% per annum simple interest for 4 years. Find the amount that she will receive after 4 years.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total **Simple Interest %** = Rate × Time = 7.5% × 4 = **30%**.

Total **Amount %** = 100% (Principal) + 30% (Interest) = **130%**.

Amount = 130% of ₹85,000 = 1.3 × 85,000 = **₹1,10,500**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,10,500.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹85,000

**Rate (R)** = 7.5% per annum

**Time (T)** = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0576f3c9c9a5bc433440367ac9c6d278f84d203eae7ae1a7788e00fd4b96d5a4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (85,000 × 7.5 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (85,000 × 30) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 850 × 30 = ₹25,500

⇒ Amount = 85,000 + 25,500

⇒ Amount = ₹1,10,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,10,500.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI remains constant every year on the same principal. SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Total Amount

The sum of Principal and Interest. A = P(1 + RT/100).

Rate and Time Relation

If the rate is R% per annum and time is T years, the total interest is (R × T)% of the principal.
